fnf-minus.title: FNF Minus - Free Online Rhythm Battle Game
fnf-minus.slogan: Minimalistic visuals meet intense rhythm battles!
fnf-minus.description: Get ready to battle in FNF Minus, where minimalistic visuals meet intense rhythm battles! Can you keep up with the beats and outshine your opponents? FNF Minus invites you to a musical party that never stops dancing. Enjoy new character designs, challenging melodies, and a unique graphic style. Play FNF Minus now and experience the thrill!

HomeIframe.title: FNF Minus
HomeIframe.description: Experience the ultimate rhythm battle in FNF Minus. Challenge yourself with new character designs and intense beats. Play now!

HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: FNF Minus is a rhythm battle game where you play as Boyfriend, engaging in rap battles to win the approval of Girlfriend. Enjoy new character designs and challenging melodies.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Use the arrow keys to match the beats.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Keep up with the rhythm to outshine your opponents.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Enjoy the unique graphic style and challenging melodies.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Every character gets a makeover based on their health bar icon.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: The songs remain the same but with increased speed and intensity.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: The entire graphic style changes, creating a new space.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Engage in rap battles to win the approval of Girlfriend.
